# MeshDrive v0.2.0-rc.2

This is a prerelease candidate, not completed physical-device acceptance.

- Transfer finalization preserves completed files after rename failures in later bookkeeping. Journal failures are isolated per shared root.
- Safe regression verification covers integrity, resume, recovery and ordinary transfer paths. The tag pipeline requires the Windows Release solution tests/build and Android unit tests, debug build and lint before publication.
- Windows packaging reuses Build-Windows.ps1. The installer and its manifest have SHA-256 checksums; the manifest records the exact source commit.
- CI does not possess the existing Android signing key and does not publish a debug APK as a release APK. A signed MeshDrive-release.apk must be built and verified locally from this same committed tag before it is added separately. Its own source/hash evidence must accompany that addition.
- Existing rc.1 assets/releases are preserved. This workflow creates a new prerelease and fails if that release already exists.

Physical Windows/Android pairing, real multi-device network interruption, installer upgrade/uninstall and user-visible UI acceptance remain separate checks in docs/MANUAL-VERIFICATION.md. Automated passes do not establish those outcomes.
